texts.en:
As the [Root.GetName] entered the [Root.solar_system.GetName] system, several drones broadcast the following message:

Welcome to Star Mall.

Our automated drones are standing by to assist you to one of our orbital parking zones. Once your vessel is powered down, our shuttles will whisk you away to the Star Mall experience. Illuminating spas, immaculate nutritional courts, and a supermassive selection of products and services await you!

Near the system's lone gas giant, the Star Mall habitat floats abandoned. No one has shopped here in a very long time.

label.zh: 它居然还这么完整真是惊奇。
label.en: Amazing it's still in one piece.
